component.name: Linux Desktop Entry Creator
component.summary: Create and manage .desktop launcher shortcuts for standalone applications

description.p: Linux Desktop Entry Creator is a modern desktop utility designed for Linux users who run standalone applications, AppImages, portable binaries, and custom scripts that do not provide a system installer.

With an intuitive graphical interface, you can easily configure application names, executable paths, icons, and categories to integrate your portable software seamlessly into your desktop environment's application menu, dock, and search grid.

ul.li: Essential launcher configuration: Application Name, Executable Path, Icon, and Category.
Live OS menu simulation and real-time .desktop code preview.
Automatic permission handling: ensures your AppImage or binary is executable (chmod +x).
Icon preservation: safely copies icons to ~/.local/share/icons/ to prevent broken references.
Advanced options: working directory path, terminal mode, and --no-sandbox flag for Electron AppImages.
Built-in application manager to launch, edit, or delete existing user-level desktop shortcuts.
